headline: One-click mastering.
Your Endgame Sound.
hero.body: Drop in your finished mix, choose a style, and hear the mastering chain as you shape it. Start simple, or open Advanced for deeper control—all running locally on your Mac or Windows PC.
hero.micro: Real-time processing. No audio upload. No YES Master account.

headline: Three decisions.
One finished master.
workflow.body: Drop in your finished mix. Choose the character, set the intensity, and pick a loudness. Listen as you go.

steps.title: Choose a style.
steps.body: Universal, Clarity, Tape or Oomph. Four distinct starting points for the sound in your head.

steps.title: Make it yours.
steps.body: Turn Intensity from a light touch to a stronger character. Hear the change while the track plays.

steps.title: Set the loudness.
steps.body: Low, Medium or High. Then hit Create Master to write a separate WAV.

workflow.support_body: Standard keeps delivery simple. Custom formats live in Advanced.

advanced.eyebrow: ADVANCED / WHEN YOU WANT THE WHOLE CONSOLE
headline: Every move.
While the music plays.
advanced.body: Shape tone, dynamics, width and warmth without stopping the track. Flip between Original and Mastered at the same playhead.
advanced.ab_note: Turn on Volume Match for a level-matched audition. It changes listening level, never the exported master.

details.title: Shape the curve. Hear the difference.
details.body: A seven-band visual EQ and tone controls put the mix’s balance in your hands.

details.title: Let it breathe. Or lean into it.
details.body: Use Preset compression, take over in Manual, or switch creative compression Off. Limiter and loudness stages stay in the path.

headline: Your ears decide.
The measurements explain.
export.body: A target is a setting. A receipt describes the rendered file. YES Master checks the result so you can judge the sound with the facts in front of you.

details.title: Loudness, delivered.
details.body: See the measured result, not just the target you selected.

details.title: Peak and dynamic range.
details.body: Understand the headroom and movement in the rendered audio.

details.title: Checks with context.
details.body: Advanced review makes quality warnings visible without treating every creative choice as a mistake.

export.source_note: Your source stays untouched. Exports are written separately.
export.standard: Filename, delivered loudness, and a Show file action. Genuine integrity problems remain visible.
export.advanced: Warning-aware Track Master review and a detailed post-render receipt.
export.report_visual: Use an actual export receipt capture. The board is a labelled field illustration, not a report or a completed test.

headline: Find your sound.
Keep your signature.
sound.body: Start with a character, not a genre label. Every style uses the same loudness and safety stages. Intensity is how you make it yours.

styles.name: Universal
styles.body: A balanced starting point that keeps the focus on your mix.

styles.name: Clarity
styles.body: An open character for more definition at the top and focus below.

styles.name: Tape
styles.body: A warmer weight and a softer edge to the transients.

styles.name: Oomph
styles.body: A bolder starting point with low-end weight and forward energy.

sound.intensity_body: Choose a style, then shape how strongly it comes through. The full chain runs as you listen.
sound.adaptive_heading: It also knows when to do less.
sound.adaptive_body: Source analysis can ease selected boosts and compression density when your mix calls for restraint. Already-processed tracks are welcome.
sound.advanced_note: Advanced adds Spatial, Warmth, Punch and Loud.

headline: One record.
Not just a folder of tracks.
album.body: Set a shared direction for the album, then make room for the tracks that need their own treatment. One delivery format brings the exports together.

details.title: One delivery format.
details.body: Mixed sample rates resolve to one album-wide rate and bit depth. Channel handling keeps the delivery consistent.

details.title: Keep an exception an exception.
details.body: Override a track to use its own sound settings and loudness target while retaining the album’s delivery format.

details.title: See each result.
details.body: Individual masters, a continuous WAV, a manifest and per-track receipts keep the record’s delivery inspectable.

album.limits: Audio mastering and delivery—not DDP authoring. No cue sheets, ISRC metadata or guaranteed gapless playback.
album.project_title: Pick up where you left off.
album.project_body: Save and reopen your session. Project files reference the original audio on disk.

headline: A real tool.
A straightforward deal.
beta.body: Free during the beta. No email gate. At paid launch, one purchase—not a subscription.
beta.pricing: Planned launch pricing: $29 founder / $49 standard. Founder-window dates and terms are announced when confirmed.

faq.a: No YES Master account. Processing runs locally on your Mac or Windows PC; audio is not uploaded for mastering.
A 44.1 kHz / 24-bit WAV, with the limiter ceiling set to −1 dBTP. Advanced adds custom delivery choices.

faq.q: Does the beta expire on my computer?
faq.a: An installed beta build keeps working when the beta closes. The installers can be withdrawn; the build has no kill switch.
Feedback is optional. Structured reports go through GitHub, which requires a GitHub account to post.

headline: Finish this track.
Start the next.
closing.body: From the first comparison to the final WAV. Less setup between you and the sound you want.
closing.micro: Mac and Windows. Runs locally. No YES Master account.
